about: The vision task cells of the Z5 lane (migrate/z5.py spec): per model its input set and ids, the vision zoo Z1's input entries (john-rocky/windows-zoo@faa4019 inputs_spec.json), the files of its forms (their public copies (the Hub file with the same sha256, or the app repo's file by URL; a file with no public copy keeps the vision zoo's PC path)) with the sha256 Z1 recorded, the upstream graph, the downstream head, the host files. Read by pc/ref_vision_task.py and pc/run_vision_task.py. Paths: {HUB} = the zoo folder's hub\ (pc/fetch.py), {FIX} = its fixtures\, {ROOT} = the zoo folder; pc/vtask.py load_spec expands them.
